headline: NQ +1.9% on a chip/AI rebound (CoreWeave beat, Nvidia bounce) into a fully priced December hike, a ~5% 10-year and a firmer dollar. The gap is priced; no edge at the open. Long above 28,406, short below 28,110.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · Veterans Day: stocks open, bond market closed, no economic data

flip.long: Go LONG if NQ holds above the overnight high 28,406 through the first 15 minutes. Target 28,500, then 28,600 (round numbers).
flip.short: Go SHORT if NQ loses ~28,110 (Tuesday high 28,109 / overnight midpoint ~28,127). Targets the Monday settle 28,014, then the gap fill at ~27,840 (overnight low 27,847.75 / Tuesday settle 27,835.25).

thesis: **STAND ASIDE** at the open, low conviction. **NQ is +527 pts / +1.89% at 28,362.25 (≈8:36 AM ET)**, near the overnight high 28,406.25 and above Tuesday's whole range, so the implied NDX open (~28,268) gaps over Tuesday's cash high 27,990 [1]. The move is micro, not macro: **CoreWeave +17% premarket** on a revenue beat and higher guide, and **Nvidia +3.7%** bouncing after a ~10% two-day drop [2,3]; AMD, AVGO and other chips lead [1,4]. The macro tape points the other way: **December hike now fully priced**, with ~15% odds of 50 bp after Goolsbee called CPI 'borderline disturbing' and Logan wants two more hikes [5], the **10-year closed Tuesday at 4.98%** (bonds are shut today) [1,2], the **dollar is +0.45% to 102.69** and **WTI +1.5% to $87.36** [1]. VIX easing to 18.4 supports the bounce [1]. With a ~1.9% gap already priced into a hawkish rate backdrop and no data or bond trading to steer it, wait: **long only above 28,406, short below ~28,110**.

bullets.label: Gap is already priced.
bullets.text: NQ is +1.9% and sits near its overnight high, with the implied NDX open above Tuesday's entire cash range [1]. Chasing a gap this size into the open carries poor risk/reward.

bullets.label: Micro vs macro conflict.
bullets.text: AI/chip news is bullish (CoreWeave beat and raised guidance; Nvidia bouncing; AMD, AVGO up 4–5%) [1,2,3], but rates are hawkish: December hike fully priced, 50 bp ~15%, Goolsbee and Logan hawkish [5].

bullets.label: No macro catalyst.
bullets.text: Veterans Day: bond market closed, no economic data; the only release was MBA mortgage applications [2,4]. Price will be driven by flows and single-stock news.

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: VIX down 5%, Nasdaq outperforming ES (+1.9% vs +0.9%), chips leading and Nvidia recovering; a clean break of 28,406 could run as shorts cover after Tuesday's CPI selloff [1,3].

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: 10-year near 5%, dollar at a two-week high and oil up; a fully priced hike plus talk of 50 bp argues against paying up for long-duration tech, so the gap may fade back toward 28,014 or the 27,840 fill [1,5]. Baird downgraded Nvidia to Neutral [4].

bullets.label: Flip to LONG:
bullets.text: NQ holds above 28,406 through the first 15 minutes with chips still leading. Targets 28,500, then 28,600.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ loses ~28,110 (Tuesday high / overnight midpoint). Targets 28,014, then ~27,840 gap fill.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: More Fed commentary; Nvidia/Huang headlines; Anthropic IPO news; oil on geopolitics. Earnings after the close: CAE, CTVA; Thursday after-close AMAT and CSCO [2,4].

sources.text: Sharecast, "US pre-open: Futures higher following CoreWeave earnings, Nvidia bounce" (Nov 11, 7:32 AM ET): NDX futures +1.95%; CoreWeave +17% on $3.66bn revenue vs $3.55bn est and raised FY guide; Nvidia +3.8%; ~90% December 25 bp hike odds; MBA applications +6.2%; no major earnings today.
Yahoo Finance live (7:34 AM ET Nov 11): NQ +1.9%, ES +0.8%, YM +0.1%; Nvidia rebounding after two days of losses; 10-year briefly above 5% Tuesday; Bowman: 'still work to do'.

Schwab Network, "U.S. Stock Futures Higher on Veteran's Day as Tech Rebounds" (Nov 11): bond market closed, no economic data; VIX 18.41; Baird downgrades NVDA to Neutral; earnings: CAE, CTVA after close; AMAT, CSCO Thursday after close.

CNBC, "Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing'" (Nov 11): FedWatch now unanimously prices a December hike, ~15% odds of 50 bp; Logan sees two more 25 bp hikes; Waller floated 50 bp. Investing.com (Nov 10, 10:21 PM): 88.8% / 11.2% for 25 / 50 bp.
